remaining_scope: None for requested UI reference set; web rebuild and behavioral implementation are outside measurement role.
reproduction: Collector phase priority obtains two sizes/input/format and attempts first dialogs; historical failed evidence retained.
Subsequent phases recover owned WPF dialog, wait for rendering, read UIA before pixels, then capture menus/dialogs in bounded requests.
Commands: python -B ui-reference-collector.py <phase>; existing phase reports/captures refuse overwrite. Fresh evidence paths and coordinated request/OS lock required.
limitations: WPF ribbon/dialog controls often have no individual native HWND or numeric ID; UIA class/automation_id/bounds supplied instead.
Original priority and first recovery reports retain failures and stale-render evidence; only approved captures are reconstruction references.
Popup/foreground appearance alone is insufficient render readiness; accepted images were opened and tools/dialog contents reviewed.
